old_problem: The source does not define 'all logs'; the proposed first twenty lines of in-band stdout omit archives and OOB/BMC sources. Clearing logs would destroy evidence, and collection can expose secrets or exhaust storage.
disposition_reason: The operation is a non-destructive diagnostic collection with a clear engineering pattern: bind the approved collector and an authoritative source manifest, then reconcile every expected source to a fresh readable hashed artifact. Tool version, source list, access and retention are Project Configuration; they do not require a new review decision. Safety is enforceable through preservation, capacity and confidentiality gates.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2156, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2157 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00044-V005 / bbad7effb537ab09 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the authentic NVDebug/NVOnline 1109504 package/procedure and an authoritative manifest of in-band host/GPU/NIC/PCIe/OS plus OOB BMC/SEL/sensor/console sources.
For each source, predeclare access path, permission, expected artifact, format, freshness/size bounds and confidentiality/redaction class.
Preflight capacity, destination, encryption/access/retention and endpoint identity; use least privilege and preserve existing logs instead of clearing them.
Retain complete stdout/stderr, archives and partial failures; generate a source-to-artifact index with timestamps, sizes, hashes and readability checks.
A process exit, truncated console excerpt or archive file list is not proof that every source was captured; missing/corrupt/redacted items stay explicit.
No NVDebug run, host/BMC access, log clear, artifact deletion, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Secure manifest-reconciled NVDebug in-band and OOB collection
test_case.purpose: Capture the complete approved diagnostic dataset from in-band and out-of-band sources, proving every required artifact is fresh, readable, intact and securely handled without destroying pre-existing evidence.
required_package: Authentic pinned NVDebug package/version/hash and approved NVOnline 1109504 procedure
Authoritative in-band/OOB source-to-artifact manifest and completeness oracle
Trusted least-privilege host, BMC and console access
Capacity threshold, secure destination, encryption/access/retention/redaction policy
Hash/index/readability tools and collection abort/recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve existing logs and establish a capacity/security baseline. Run the approved NVDebug in-band and OOB procedures once, retaining complete stdout/stderr, archives and partial errors. Hash and index each fresh artifact and reconcile every required source to the frozen manifest; do not clear source logs or accept truncated stdout as completion evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Every required in-band and OOB source maps to a fresh, non-empty, readable artifact with valid timestamp, size and hash; no collection error, missing source, archive corruption, storage exhaustion, instability or uncontrolled sensitive-data exposure occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete manifest reconciliation and integrity/security checks. FAIL on any unapproved missing, stale, empty, unreadable or corrupt artifact, collection error, capacity/health breach or confidentiality violation. Missing tool, manifest, trusted access or policy is BLOCKED at runtime, not an unresolved review decision.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until package provenance, source manifest, trusted access, capacity and confidentiality/retention controls are signed.
Never clear or overwrite pre-existing host/BMC evidence.
Stop on storage/inode threshold, host/BMC instability, archive corruption, unexpected privilege escalation or uncontrolled sensitive data.
Preserve partial outputs and do not automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVDebug version/hash and procedure revision
Frozen source manifest with in-band/OOB path, expected artifact and confidentiality class
Capacity/inode/access-control/retention preflight and authenticated endpoint identities
Complete raw archives and untruncated stdout/stderr
Unchanged source logs, final host/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On capacity, stability, corruption or security failure, stop and secure the partial archive/manifest and error output. Restore service only under the approved platform procedure; handle retention or deletion solely under the signed data policy, and do not clear sources or rerun until the cause and duplicate-artifact policy are resolved.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require complete NVDebug capture; the source-list gap is Project Configuration, not a conflicting objective.

blocked.reason: The collection semantics and safe acceptance model are complete; runtime remains gated on approved tooling, manifest, access, capacity and data-handling policy.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED COLLECTION GATE CLOSED; NO NVDEBUG, HOST/BMC ACCESS, LOG CLEAR, ARTIFACT DELETE, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed collector, source manifest, access, capacity and data policy and authorize the collection; no new review decision is required absent a changed collection scope.

external_authorities.application: Requires purpose-fit commands, complete direct artifacts, secure access, preservation, recovery and no result-hiding retry.
